response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), qualifying_statuses AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, s.avg_modindex - o.avg_modindex AS above_overall_average FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_average, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying_statuses;
